steps.name: Gray Blot (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Saraswati] in “Compartment 3” and report the quest to [Irfan] in “Elysia 2”.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I sent you a message because %s's new memories were discovered within the hyperspace network. Please access again like last time… .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: %s? Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I went to sleep, but I guess I'm still tired. A lot of things happened at the same time... . It'll be okay now... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Can you tell me what you've been going through recently?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, then… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Saraswati about your visit to Elysia.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: This is an unbelievable story... . There is another world... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Well, there are several worlds that I have figured out, so you say something like that... . As a manager, you shouldn't do that... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… , Then can I just touch it like last time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why can't I see it?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: An error message is displayed saying that the task cannot be performed now. After checking the log, it seems that certain conditions must be met.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Etoire's time was shaken as the time spirit in Pneuma stopped briefly, very briefly, due to something caused by the god Hecateran.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: And the space-time network was also affected. Although it is very subtle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I would like you to ask Elysia's manager.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Administrator… .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I don't know, but I'll see if I can change the terms. Still, once in a place called Elysia… .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Oh, Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Saraswati. sorry.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: If you don't feel like doing it, you don't have to do it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It’s okay, I’ll come back… . But what do you ask?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Hmm… . I think the keyword memory would be good.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Saraswati. Then I will come right away.

steps.name: Gray Blot (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Irrfan] in 「Elysia 2」, obtain 100 <Agni's Mana Scepters>, and report the quest to [Irrfan].

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: There you are.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Irrfan.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I thought you would come back someday, but I didn't know it would come like this.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Okay, what's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Somehow I feel like I have to come back here.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: That's disingenuous. I don't know if this will answer that feeling, but let me help you out a bit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean by that?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Am I saying this now? Listen quietly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: How do you remember what happened in Jude Kingdom?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I went from Freios to Eastland to look for Iris. and… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Then, what did you experience in Jude Kingdom?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I am the chief of the Agni clan who was used by Ban and Mara... . for a moment… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I am a member of the Agni clan... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of the Agni clan… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Even when you came to Elysia, you were not aware of your identity as Agni.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Depending on your choice, I may be able to help. As the chieftain of the clan, it was natural for me to help my descendants.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What should I do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You seem reluctant. Then go back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. That's not it... . I will do it.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Once again, it's your choice. And I'm just giving a little help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I didn't know there would be someone like you among my descendants... . I can't help it.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Get me some items from Eastland. Those items will awaken your forgotten memories in Elysia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What items do you need?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Bring a lot of [Agni's Mana Scepter] hidden in [Sun God's Underground Altar]. I think it would be okay if it was something full of fiery will.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Then I'll tell you what to bring next.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

steps.name: Gray Blot (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Irrfan] in 「Elysia 2」, obtain 100 each of <Snake Shadow Horn> and <Snake Shadow Scale> from 「Star of Nothingness」 and report the quest to [Irrfan].

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Have you been there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: This Mana Scepter is the materialization of the power of the sun god Agni, which could be its source.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Now, can you see it?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What you brought is glowing redder than any mana scepter I know.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I thought Elysia, where the ancient gods stayed, was giving you a gift... , Bring the mana scepter you brought to your chest.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I'd like to think I'm cautious because I'm very suspicious, but that doesn't suit Agni.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.
(The moment the mana hole touches %s's chest, the burning crystal turns into a flame and goes straight into it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gagging… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mmm, my head is hot. Me, I… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaaa!!

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: This is how the Agni clan overcomes fear. Don't be afraid. If you think that your own soul is awakening... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Ha, ha... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I guess that's enough now. Does something come to mind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . I am… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When Van and Mara attacked the village, my father told me to take refuge in a secret hidden altar... . The chief said he would save the village... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I went to the Holy Land, and traveled according to the will of Goddess Ceres... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It was the beginning of a journey to find the person who would become the Holy God. So what was it like when you came to Jude Kingdom?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, that… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The clan attacked Jude Kingdom because of Ban and Mara's magic stones, and my father had no choice but to save the clan... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What happened after that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I… . I am… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Seeing as you don't recognize that part of your soul is Agni, I guess I'll have to go there one more time.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: There is a snake that transcends the ages and occasionally appears from the planet of nothingness. Did you say snake shadow? You defeated the one that appeared recently, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Has that appeared before?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I've seen that snake before, and the sight of it trying to swallow a soul was quite impressive. Although he disappeared quickly... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Since you said you swallowed your own soul, if it's something from a snake like that, it might be able to help you.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: If you go to the planet of nothingness, there will still be something left. I think it would be good to bring plenty, like mana halls.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Why are you so dazed? Be glad it wasn't an ordeal... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

steps.name: Gray Blot (4)
steps.objective: Talk to [Irrfan] in “Elysia 2”, return to [Saraswati] in “Compartment 3”, talk to her, and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You look very tired.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've been there.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Use your power to mix the horns and scales of the snake shadow and turn them into powder. The heat flowing from your Gigantfall will be enough.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: And collect the powder in both hands, praying that the soul like the sand of the hot desert will awaken.
(As Irfan said, grind the horns and scales of the snake shadow into powder and collect them in your hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I do it like this?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Close your eyes and pray.
(The powder in his hand turns into a flame and goes up %s's arm and heads toward his head.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Don't be scared. Because under the influence of your soul, the solar flame you embrace has been ignited into a flame of purification.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hot, hot… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaaa!!

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I'm full of fear... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did I... Father… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You're awake. Your memories from that time... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Irrfan, why did I… . Father… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Don't be surprised and listen to me.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: In the newly organized time, Aslan got a chance. You must have doubts about the whole situation. The characters of Jude Kingdom are talking about strange things... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The King of Jude Kingdom forgave his friend Aslan and acted leniently by allowing him to reflect on himself in prison.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Even though he cooperated with the enemy, it wasn't Aslan's crime... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: At that time, you would have sorted out the affairs of Jude Kingdom and headed to Luman without a care in the world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. That's what I did... . however… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It's you, and the new memories that come to mind are also you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I resented my father for letting me escape, became hostile, and fought in anger.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I shouldn’t have done that, but how dare I… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Aslan was helpless at that time. You must have wanted to die. He must have wanted to erase the sorrow of losing his family, even at the hands of his beloved child.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: So in that time you killed Aslan and continued your journey.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Father… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Don't be too sad.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How dare I tell my father… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: However, that time has been modified. You may not like it, but Hecate was the one who touched it some of the time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I don't know why Hecate did that. However, what is certain is that a being more superior than the Old Gods wanted that time.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Your collapse and downfall, and the destruction of the world... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You know it too. You were different in different times.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can’t deny it… The drifting city is also like that…)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: One of them is you, who is here right now. They are descendants of the Agni clan.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Irfan… . I… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You mean Aslan?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Aslan of this era will not remember you.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: As time was modified, Aslan became childless... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why… Why did it happen like that?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: That's true for Hecate, but Iris's abilities that she used to save you got mixed up and that's what happened.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: God does not want his people to turn into Agashura. And if you, a descendant of the sun god, change... Because it could be the worst.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Father… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The current situation is good for you, who will go through a lot in the future, and for Aslan, who is dreaming of rebuilding his clan while locked in a dungeon.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What do you think would happen if you went to Aslan and told him the truth? .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Iris's time, which saved you, will also have a negative impact... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: There is no answer as of now. This is the best... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Anyway, you live with this memory planted in your head. Whether you like it or not, it's you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you helping me?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: That's because you are of the same clan.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I were a different version of myself... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: That would have been a different story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Next time, I hope that instead of this kind of story, it will be your own new story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll just go back... . good bye.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You seem quite shocked... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Your tears may wet the flame in your heart for now, but they will soon rekindle it as nourishment... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: %s, are you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Did you get an answer from Elysia's administrator?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a bit difficult to tell... .
(Saraswati nods understandingly at %s’s embarrassed expression.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: It's okay. The problem has been resolved, but it is Adventurer's authority whether to use it or not.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: We have created a separate secure folder. You can come and access it whenever you want.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Saraswati.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: By the way, it seems that Adventurer's memory keyword still has various effects on the hyperspace network.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: At some point, the error was corrected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: You can revisit some of your memories by accessing them later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand, Saraswati. Then I'll go down again. good bye.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes… . Goodbye… .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Today’s Adventurer is codenamed Agni… .
